verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times is a fair axis. The evidence only shows that the AI assistant can 'check your calendar' and 'write drafts', and that the AI can connect to Calendar. Those are adjacent capabilities. Nothing documents an availability-sharing or bookable-slot insertion feature in the composer.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
